body.name: Canonical-arc parametric cylindrical-algebraic atlas procedure
body.construction: For rational or real-algebraic observed summaries and endpoints of \(\mathcal B\), \(\mathsf{ATLAS}\) treats \((\Gamma_A,\Gamma_0,\Gamma_1)\in\mathcal B\) as parameters.  It separates the point-identified strata \(\Gamma_A=1\) and \(\Gamma_0=\Gamma_1=1\); on every remaining stratum it sets \(W_{\Gamma_A}(t)=\Gamma_A t/\{1+(\Gamma_A-1)t\}\), represents the forward exposure arc by the complement involution on \(U\), and constructs the lower and upper objectives only on the canonical arc \((w_0,w_1)=(W_{\Gamma_A}(t),t)\).  It then eliminates the legal mixture-root and one-dimensional stationary variables, including all saturated denominator and endpoint cases, and performs parametric cylindrical algebraic decomposition over \(K_{\mathrm{in}}\).  The output consists of exact quantifier-free sign cells and algebraic optimizer strata, including legal-root collisions and stationary continua; rational isolating intervals are returned only after a zero-dimensional specialization.
